actual_scope: The one-index off-diagonal exchange for the six-source depth-two connector at characteristic 7. Exactly one index in 4..22 fails the weight-3 test on s+t=45, and one pair off that diagonal may be used to replace the lost mask. This package proves that the early pair (0,3) plus that one off-diagonal pair still leaves at least one of the 20 weight-3 masks unrealized. The cover is at most 19 and a literal word attains 19. Unrestricted c=7 existence stays open.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the unsigned dirty connector alphabet fixed and answers the released one-index exchange left open by the empty diagonal equality case: Nick Petalas's 2026-11-03 handoff, open question 1 of the equality-case note. A new operation is not the missing step.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. It does not change a supplier, a consumer, or kappa. It bounds the one-index replacement inside the weight-3 count at c=7 and leaves the full depth-two question open.
stop_rule: Stop once every one-failure chain is classified and one off-diagonal pair is shown not to finish the 20 weight-3 masks, or stop if a legal chain and one off-diagonal pair cover all 20.
evidence: The only possible single failed index in 4..22 is the centre s=22. The free-type chain on s=4..21 is an exact layered graph. Of 108 off-diagonal slots, 82 are killed by coordinate bounds, (12,12) repeats the diagonal mask, the 380 novel realizations at (9,15), (10,14) and (11,13) repeat a diagonal mask so the image has size at most 17, and (33,33) repeats a mask in the first nine indices. One new mask plus (0,3) therefore reaches at most 19. The witness 023514103524310254054123145203452034213150 attains 19 and misses (1,3,5). A one-letter mutation is rejected.

open_questions.question: Can two off-diagonal weight-3 pairs finish the 20-mask count when the diagonal image has size at most 17?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One new pair plus (0,3) stops at 19, while two new pairs have room to reach 20. An image of size 18 has no off-diagonal mask outside itself.
open_questions.first_step: Keep the centre as the only failed index and test whether the (9,15) complement and one other new pair, from (10,14), (11,13), or (33,33), can be new at once and disjoint from (0,3).
open_questions.blocked_by: Those pairs constrain the same suffix, and this package does not enumerate their joint realizations.

open_questions.question: Which non-weight-3 masks does the 19-cover witness miss?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A depth-two block needs every nonzero mask, so a completed weight-3 count would still not decide c=7.
open_questions.first_step: Evaluate q_s + q_t on the one witness word for weights other than 3 and list the missing masks.
open_questions.blocked_by: The state graph here tracks only weight-3 diagonal sums. It is not an unrestricted word search.
